Add Data — Dye House Weekly Entry
Jump:
21 dye machine downtime hours (weekly). Label + Hours box each.
Excel / CSV Import DOWNTIME
Expected columns: Date; Shift; Machine + 21 machine codes (WDBK … DCDD). Cell values = downtime minutes; the weekly total of each code is divided by 60 (→ hours) and fills the matching box below.
Weekly PTP Excel Import
Upload the PTP SUMMARY sheet Excel (.xlsx / .xls / .csv). Required columns: Date; BEHIND; AHEAD; PLANNED WEIGHT (Kg); ACTUAL WEIGHT (Kg) — all imported days update the Weekly Behind / Ahead / Weight charts.
Down Time Manual Values
Enter the weekly Total Machine Capacity — numbers only (applied instantly on change).
Machine Utilization One Excel · RK + Batch
Upload ONE Excel (.xlsx / .xls). Rows with Actual Machine = EH85H9 / FP85H10 are removed first, then: RK ← SUM(Working Minutes) ÷ 60 of the rows whose Dye Batch Number starts with “RK” · Batch ← SUM(Working Minutes) ÷ 60 of all other rows. The boxes can also be typed manually.
Required column headers (all must be present): Actual Dye Module · Actual Machine · Plan Machine · Machine Size · Ready Date · Dye Batch Number · Fabric content · Customer Color Description · Internal Color Code · Batch Weight · Garments per Batch · Total Pieces · Efficiency · Customer · Customer Style Description · Customer Color Code · Entry Date · Additions · Standard Minutes · Working Minutes
